title: Basic Surgical Skills

title: Research Paper Presentation
subtitle: Academic Event
tagline: Medicine advances not merely through what we know, but through what we dare to question
about: From curiosity to investigation, and from evidence to innovation, every breakthrough begins with a question. This event is a platform for aspiring medical researchers to present their scientific work, challenge established perspectives and share discoveries that contribute to the future of healthcare.
items: Stage 1, abstract submission (deadline 12 Dec 2026, 11:59 PM): mandatory for preliminary screening; maximum 500 words
Sections: Title, Introduction, Objectives, Methodology, Results and Conclusion, key words
First page must include event name, research title and authors
Times New Roman (title 18 bold, main text 12); PDF only; file name “Research Paper – Short Title”
IEC clearance certificate must be uploaded separately
Abstracts are reviewed by faculty and shortlisted finalists are notified
Stage 2, presentation: 8 minutes plus 2 minutes Q&A; maximum 20 slides; Times New Roman mandatory
Report one hour before the event; submit the PowerPoint on a pen drive
rules: Plagiarism is strictly prohibited and leads to immediate disqualification
The decision of the judges is final
fee: Abstract submission free · shortlisted participants pay the Basic Delegate fee (₹500)
artworkAlt: A scholar presents an illustrated medical manuscript to two attentive reviewers.

title: Poster Presentation
subtitle: Academic Event
tagline: Every discovery has a story. Every observation holds a possibility
about: A platform for aspiring medical professionals to turn scientific knowledge, clinical experiences and research findings into compelling visual presentations. Simplify complex concepts and let your research speak through visual storytelling.
items: Format: 3 ft (W) × 4 ft (H), portrait only; landscape or oversized prints are disqualified
Original research: Title, Authors/Affiliation, Introduction, Methodology, Results, Discussion, Conclusion, key references (3–5)
Case report: Title, Authors/Affiliation, Introduction, Case Presentation, Discussion, Conclusion, References
Readable from 4–6 ft with sans-serif fonts (title 72–90 pt, headings 36–48 pt, body 24–28 pt or more); 300–500 words; high-resolution graphs (300 DPI)
Ethics and blind judging: mask patient eyes and identifying features (consent mandatory), mention the IEC approval number for research, omit college logos and names from the poster body
Timing: 5 minutes presentation plus 2 minutes Q&A; report 30 minutes early to mount the poster
fee: Abstract submission free · shortlisted participants pay the Basic Delegate fee (₹500)
artworkAlt: A presenter explains a medical chart on an easel to a seated scholar.

title: Clinical Case Presentation
subtitle: Academic Event
tagline: Every patient tells a story. Every symptom offers a clue
about: A platform for aspiring doctors to showcase clinical acumen, diagnostic reasoning and problem-solving through compelling case presentations. Demonstrate the art of thinking like a clinician.
items: Stage 1, abstract submission (deadline 12 Dec 2026, 11:59 PM): Introduction, History, Examination Findings, Investigations, Provisional and Differential Diagnosis, Discussion
Maximum 500 words; PDF only; Times New Roman; title 14 pt, main text 12 pt; line spacing 1.5
Abstracts are reviewed by faculty and shortlisted participants are notified in advance
Stage 2, presentation: 7 minutes plus 2 minutes Q&A; report one hour before the event
Cover patient particulars, presenting complaints, clinical findings, differential diagnosis, investigations, management and clinical course
Patient-identifying information must not be disclosed
Evaluated on: history and examination, diagnostic approach, interpretation of investigations, management, presentation skills, response to questions
rules: Plagiarism is strictly prohibited and leads to immediate disqualification
The decision of the judges is final
fee: Abstract submission free · shortlisted participants pay the Basic Delegate fee (₹500)
artworkAlt: A physician discusses an illustrated casebook beside a seated patient and senior colleague.
